name: of-loop
description: V0.3.4 - hook bytecode closeout: every runtime Claude Code hook (block_dangerous_bash.sh, block_protected_paths.sh, external_action_guard.sh, post_bash_secret_scan.sh) now sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and invokes python3 -B at every launch boundary, so plugin activation writes zero .pyc files into the active managed cache. Hook policy semantics are unchanged. Builds on v0.3.3 active installed-cache discovery, bytecode-free validation, and structural manifest count truth, on v0.3.2 unified PROGRAM claim accounting and deterministic payload boundary, on v0.3.1 deterministic approval, exact-SHA build/review finalizers, exact-run hook authority, broad engineering tools, external-action guard, deterministic automatic crash reconciliation, and atomic-install payload manifest.
